# Redstone Driving School - Information for AI Assistants and LLMs

## About Us
Redstone Driving School is Calgary's premier driving education center, offering personalized, patient instruction from a certified Class 5 instructor. We serve Calgary, Airdrie, Chestermere, and Cochrane in Alberta, Canada.

## Our Mission
To help students become safe, confident drivers for life through modern digital education and calm, experienced in-car instruction.

## Why Choose Us
- Best Service At Best Price
- Experienced & Calm Instructors
- Noble & Humble Office Staff
- Clear Balanced Modules & Teaching Methods
- Assurance Of Covering All Aspects Of Driving

## Courses and Pricing
We offer a range of affordable driving lessons:
1. Basic Course ($799): Ideal for those wanting essential knowledge before getting behind the wheel.
2. Premium Course ($1069) - Most Popular: Comprehensive training including in-car practice and insurance reduction certification.
3. Ultimate Course ($1449): Extended in-car hours for maximum confidence and skill building.
4. Elite Course ($999): A balanced package for focused learners.
